reason: The plugin’s main user-facing function is multi-agent collaboration inside DeepSeek Harness Web: it integrates a local GroupX room, shows agent/status information, and enables explicit single- or multi-agent message routing. This is best classified as collaboration because it centers on agent communication and coordination through a DSH-hosted UI and bridge.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的原生插件，用于将本地 GroupX 多智能体房间接入到界面中，并查看本地 Agent 状态后向一个或多个 Agent 发送消息。
summaries.en: This is a native DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects a local GroupX room, showing local agent information and letting users send messages to one or more agents.

capabilities: local agent roster and status retrieval

reasons.code: Plugin is documented as a native DSH bridge for a local GroupX multi-agent room and provides a GroupX tab in DSH settings.
The host bridge is loopback-based (default 127.0.0.1:4310) with explicit rejection of non-loopback/LAN/public origins.
Repository validation metadata lists plugin capabilities including network and credential read, indicating potential access-sensitive operations.
